name: IsolatedFooting
description: Reinforcement detailing for ONE rectangular isolated (pad) footing, per specs/isolated-footing.md. Ships one button, Isolated Footing RFT, on the shared RFT-Tools ribbon tab beside the beam and column tools -- pyRevit merges tabs by title, so this is a separate extension that lands on the same tab. Versioned and released independently, as footing/vX.Y.Z.
author: Essam Kader
